concerns.location: tasks.md:Phase 3 – Baseline computation & FTLE sweep (User Story 2, P2) – Task T011
concerns.text: Task T011 adds a gating step that must be executed *before* any noisy FTLE computation. Since the FTLE sweep (Task T010) runs earlier in the same phase, the gating logic would not be in place when T010 is executed, violating the producer‑before‑consumer ordering.

concerns.location: tasks.md:Phase 4 – Statistical modelling, regression and visualisation (User Story 3, P3) – Task T012
concerns.text: Task T012 requires a "clean finite‑time baseline" for every window size T (FR‑010). The only baseline task (T009) produces a single asymptotic baseline JSON, not per‑window baselines. No producer task creates the per‑window baseline artifacts needed by T012, resulting in a missing dependency.

concerns.location: tasks.md:Phase 1 – Project bootstrap & reproducible environment – Task T001
concerns.text: Task T001 is marked `[P]` (parallel‑safe) but writes a single file `state/dir_structure.txt`. Running this task in parallel with other tasks that also write to `state/` could cause race conditions, so the `[P]` tag is inaccurate.
